name: Limit Telemetry Plan
description: Persist provider-limit adherence telemetry for judgment jobs and show the last 3 days on the job detail page.

userStories.title: Add provider telemetry sample schema
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a DuckDB telemetry sample table so provider-limit history can be stored independently of admin page views.
acceptanceCriteria: The table stores `id`, `created_at`, `job_id`, `project_id`, `provider_key`, `sampled_at`, provider capacity and lease counts, provider versions, bottleneck fields, worker coverage fields, `aggregate_completeness`, and optional compact `snapshot_json`.

The schema has primary key `id`, unique key `(job_id, provider_key, sampled_at)`, retention index `(sampled_at)`, and checks for non-empty IDs/provider keys, non-negative counts, and valid `aggregate_completeness` values.
The schema does not add a duplicate `(job_id, provider_key, sampled_at)` query index beyond the unique key.

userStories.title: Add telemetry bucket and adherence helpers
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want shared pure helpers for telemetry ranges, utilization, adherence, and bottleneck summaries so service, route, and UI behavior stay deterministic.
acceptanceCriteria: Add helpers for range presets `5m`, `15m`, `1h`, `24h`, and `3d` with the bucket sizes and complete-window semantics from the PRD.
Range helpers return inclusive `rangeStart`, exclusive `rangeEnd`, and `rangeEnd` floored to the preset bucket size.
Utilization helpers use `provider_request_fill_pct` when available and recompute from live leases and normal request capacity when needed.
Utilization is `null` when normal request capacity is zero, `100` means full normal request capacity, and over-limit samples may exceed `100`.
Adherence helpers derive `overLimit`, `atLimit`, `withinLimit`, and `unknown` with worst-state bucket precedence.
Bottleneck helpers choose the dominant bottleneck by highest sample count, break ties by latest sample, and take source/subreason from the selected latest sample.
Empty buckets are generated for the full aligned range.

userStories.title: Implement telemetry history service
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a server service for inserting, pruning, and querying telemetry samples so persistence and chart aggregation are centralized.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `src/server/services/judgmentProviderTelemetryHistoryService.ts` with functions for inserting samples, pruning samples older than 3 days, deleting samples for a job, and querying bucketed history.
Sample insertion normalizes `sampled_at` to the 30 second cadence-slot start and uses `created_at` only for insertion time.
Sample insertion uses `ON CONFLICT(job_id, provider_key, sampled_at) DO NOTHING` for cadence-slot deduplication.
Bucketed queries return `rangeStart`, `rangeEnd`, `bucketSizeSeconds`, `providerKey`, and ordered bucket rows with utilization, adherence, sample count, and bottleneck summary fields.
Bucket aggregation ignores null utilization values and returns null average/min/max when a bucket has no usable utilization samples.
Service tests cover insert dedupe, pruning, deletion by job, aligned buckets, null utilization, over-limit utilization, adherence precedence, and bottleneck tie-breaking.

userStories.title: Wire deletion and retention cleanup
userStories.description: As an operator, I want provider telemetry samples deleted with their owning job and pruned after retention so telemetry does not accumulate stale data.
acceptanceCriteria: `deleteJudgmentJobSafelyTx` deletes telemetry samples for the job before deleting the `app.judgment_job` row in the same transaction path.
`judgmentsJobsCleanupStale` prunes telemetry samples older than the 3 day retention window during maintenance cleanup.
Deletion tests prove telemetry samples are removed when a judgment job is deleted.
Cleanup tests prove samples newer than 3 days remain and samples older than 3 days are pruned.

userStories.title: Add server-side telemetry sampler
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the server to sample running active jobs every 30 seconds so telemetry history is not biased by admin page polling.
acceptanceCriteria: Extract shared live-route and sampler input building from `/api/judgmentsjobs/:id`, including endpoint diagnostics enrichment, so live snapshots and persisted samples use the same provider telemetry assembly.
Add a dedicated maintenance cron sampler with pattern `*/30 * * * * *` and an in-process overlap guard.
The sampler no-ops when the current server role should not run maintenance loops or cannot access the judgment read model.
The sampler uses `judgmentsJobsGetRunningJobs({applyRuntimeMatchFilter: false})` so endpoint/runtime-unavailable states are still sampled.
The sampler stores one sample per active `(job_id, provider_key, sampled_at)` cadence slot and relies on service-level conflict handling for cross-process overlap.
Cron tests cover role gating, overlap guard behavior, running-job discovery, and sampler invocation.

userStories.title: Add telemetry history API endpoint
userStories.description: As a client developer, I want a flat Eden API endpoint for provider telemetry history so the job detail page can request stable chart buckets.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `GET /api/judgmentsjobs-provider-telemetry-history` with query input `jobId`, optional `providerKey`, and `range` in `5m | 15m | 1h | 24h | 3d`.
When `providerKey` is omitted, the route defaults to the current job provider key instead of aggregating unrelated provider keys.

The route returns `rangeStart`, `rangeEnd`, `bucketSizeSeconds`, `providerKey`, and ordered bucket rows with `bucketStart`, `bucketEnd`, `sampleCount`, `avgUtilization`, `minUtilization`, `maxUtilization`, `adherenceState`, and bottleneck summary fields.
The route returns empty buckets for the requested aligned range when no samples exist.
Route tests cover valid ranges, invalid ranges, provider-key defaulting, empty history, utilization null handling, and bottleneck summary behavior.

userStories.title: Add client telemetry history service and labels
userStories.description: As a UI developer, I want typed client fetch helpers and shared labels so the chart can consume the telemetry history API through existing app patterns.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `fetchJudgmentJobProviderTelemetryHistory` and response types in `src/services/judgmentsJobsService.ts` using Eden, not `fetch`.
Add or update shared helpers for range labels, adherence-state labels, utilization formatting, and bottleneck summary display used by the job detail UI.
Client query inputs include `jobId`, `range`, and optional `providerKey` without inventing parallel route contracts.
`jobsPageShared.test.ts` covers adherence labels, range labels, utilization formatting, and bottleneck summary labels.

userStories.title: Render job detail telemetry history chart
userStories.description: As an admin user, I want a utilization history chart on the job detail page so I can inspect provider-limit adherence over recent time ranges.
acceptanceCriteria: Render the telemetry history chart near `JobTelemetryPanel` while preserving the existing live Provider Capacity Telemetry snapshot.
Use `useQuery` from `@tanstack/solid-query` with local loading, error, and empty-history UI inside the chart panel.
Do not suspend the route, do not add a full-page spinner, and do not add a new chart dependency.
Add range preset controls for `5m`, `15m`, `1h`, `24h`, and `3d`.
The chart displays average, minimum, and maximum utilization per bucket and exposes the bucket adherence state and bottleneck summary in readable text or tooltips.
The panel is mobile-safe and does not introduce horizontal page overflow.
Browser verification for chart range switching, empty history, and mobile overflow on the admin job detail page passes

userStories.title: Add end-to-end telemetry chart coverage
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want browser coverage for the telemetry history chart so chart rendering, range switching, empty history, and responsive layout remain protected.
acceptanceCriteria: Update Playwright telemetry fixtures to mock `GET /api/judgmentsjobs-provider-telemetry-history` responses.
Add Playwright coverage for rendering populated telemetry history buckets on the admin job detail page.
Add Playwright coverage for range switching and the empty-history state.
Add Playwright coverage or assertions that the telemetry history chart does not create horizontal overflow at mobile width.
Browser verification confirms chart range switching, empty history, and mobile overflow behavior in the admin job detail page.
